# idealo Italy

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

| [GET /v1/idealo/search](#get-v1idealosearch---1-credit-standard) | 1 credit (standard) | Returns idealo Italy products for a keyword search with the lowest price in euros and… | Use it to compare Italian market prices for a product type, Italy only. |

## GET /v1/idealo/product - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one idealo Italy product by its idealo link: the product id, name, brand, image, stock, the lowest price in euros and the shops' offers in `product.ext.idealo.offers`, each with the shop, its exact price, its delivery note and idealo's link to the offer, lowest price first. `offer_count` is idealo's own count and can be higher than the offers listed. idealo's page text is not a product description, so `product.description` is null. Italy (idealo.it) only.

**Use when** you want to see which Italian shops sell a product and at what price.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - The product's idealo Italy link, as it appears on idealo.it, for example https://www.idealo.it/confronta-prezzi/203235721/apple-iphone-15.html. Every row of GET /v1/idealo/search carries it as product.url. · e.g. `https://www.idealo.it/confronta-prezzi/203235721/apple-iphone-15.html`
- `country` (optional, enum: IT) - Marketplace. idealo is covered for Italy (idealo.it) only, so the one value is IT, the default.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls}; `product.ext` {idealo}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}. Never filled: `product.rating.average`, `product.rating.count`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/idealo/product" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.idealo.it/confronta-prezzi/203235721/apple-iphone-15.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/idealo/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns idealo Italy products for a keyword search, about 30 a page for up to 100 pages, with idealo's total for the search: the product id, name, idealo product link, image, the lowest price in euros across the shops and `product.ext.idealo.offer_count`, how many shop offers idealo compares. Italy (idealo.it) only. For the offers themselves call GET /v1/idealo/product with the row's product.url. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare Italian market prices for a product type, Italy only.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈34/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/34) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Product keywords, 1 to 200 characters, for example iphone 15. · e.g. `iphone 15`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number from 1 to 100. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `country` (optional, enum: IT) - Marketplace. idealo is covered for Italy (idealo.it) only, so the one value is IT, the default.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls}; `product.ext` {idealo}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}. Never filled: `product.rating.average`, `product.rating.count`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/idealo/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=iphone 15" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
